title: plugin-security: member_default grants sys_comment_reaction read + create, so a stock member can react to comments they can read
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czXwx6JtQPvacrzzUw

Area-lease pilot #33059, lease:E1. Maintainer decision 2026-11-15T01:40Z: option A, "members may react by default". This settles the open question on #22566 of which shipped set carries these bits, for `member_default` only.

## Premise (measured on main ba35dfd7, E1)
A stock showcase member has no grant on `sys_comment_reaction`. The record page falls back to the column store and offers the reaction control. Clicking it PATCHes the retired `sys_comment.reactions` column and answers 400 INVALID_FIELD, while `POST /data/sys_comment_reaction` answers 403.

## Fix
- In `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`, `member_default` gets `sys_comment_reaction: { allowRead: true, allowCreate: true, allowEdit: false, allowDelete: false }`, beside the `sys_comment` line. No row policy: the tripwire in default-permission-sets.test.ts forbids one.
- `external_default` is not covered. Portal users keep today's answer unless that is ruled separately.
- Update the header of `comment-reaction-own-record-floor.test.ts`, which calls this "an open decision on #22566".
- Add a dogfood pin: a stock member reacts to a readable comment (201), unreacts their own reaction, cannot remove another member's reaction, and reads reactions only on comments they can read.

## Why it is safe (reviewed)
- Reads are narrowed to readable comments (`installCommentReadVisibility`).
- Inserts refuse unreadable comments and stamp `user_id` from the session (`authorizeReactionInsert`).
- Unreact removes only `created_by == caller` rows, and there is no update method.

## Out of scope
The console store-choice bug is #33521.
